addressed.claim_id: Fixed duplicate/conflict payload to include reference: seen now stores 4-tuple (account, currency, amount, reference) and compares all four fields against first occurrence, so differing reference is correctly a conflict.
Fixed key/account emptiness validation to check len==0 (non-empty string) instead of .strip(), aligning with spec that whitespace-only strings are non-empty.

Remove hardcoded DST fallback in task_b.py (last Sunday of March heuristic) that violated spec rule 9. Now relies solely on zoneinfo round-trip for gap detection via ZoneInfo("Europe/Madrid") with no ascii/hard-coded emulation. task_a.py and task_c.py retained as compliant (validation before seen-map, currency normalization, Decimal quantization, abs(old) handling, ROUND_HALF_UP to exponent -2).
